# Repository Agent Skills

These skills guide AI coding agents working in this repository.

## Inviteora
- [Inviteora Invitation Builder](inviteora-invitation-builder/SKILL.md) — standalone invitation HTML/CSS/JS, media, preview/edit workflows.
- [GitHub Pages Release Check](github-pages-release-check/SKILL.md) — repository asset, catalog, and GitHub Pages validation.

## Shopify
- [Shopify Workflow Orchestrator](shopify-workflow-orchestrator/SKILL.md) — routes and coordinates full storefront projects.
- [Shopify Theme Development](shopify-theme-development/SKILL.md) — Liquid, sections, snippets, JSON templates, theme settings.
- [Shopify Storefront Design](shopify-storefront-design/SKILL.md) — mobile-first visual design and customer experience.
- [Product and Collection Optimization](shopify-product-collection-optimization/SKILL.md) — catalog structure, product pages, collections, filters.
- [Performance, SEO, and Accessibility](shopify-performance-seo-accessibility/SKILL.md) — speed, search, structured data, accessible UX.
- [Storefront QA](shopify-storefront-qa/SKILL.md) — browser-based regression and responsive testing.
- [Store Operations](shopify-store-operations/SKILL.md) — safe Admin workflows and release controls.

## Usage
Read the relevant skill before starting a task. For multi-step Shopify work, start with the orchestrator and then read the specialist skills it routes to. These are repository instructions for compatible coding agents; they do not install a Shopify app or grant store access.
